## Over 50 million tons of CO2e on our platform to date.

## Legacy infrastructure can't keep up with a trillion-dollar environmental market.

Today’s registries and developers rely on manual processes that slow down credit issuance and limit transparency.

Alcove replaces fragmented workflows with a unified, auditable data layer that connects the entire value chain from project data to issued credits to market settlement.

## Our  Product Suite

[**Developer Cloud**\\
\\
Developer Cloud digitizes MRV workflows, automates QA/QC, and accelerates audit readiness with ease.\\
\\
![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f9f3cbd9d57d34d84f790f/66eb46af6bddcf9794f8c7f6_facilityaudit.png)](https://www.alcove.io/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-0) [**Registry Cloud**\\
\\
Trusted by standards like Puro.Earth, Registry Cloud powers verification, issuance, and inventory management for modern crediting systems.\\
\\
![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f9f3cbd9d57d34d84f790f/66eb464ee8f83cd0682aa790_forkliftTransport.png)](https://www.alcove.io/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-1) [**Inventory Management**\\
\\
Leverage a unified dashboard for holdings, retirements, and transfers to bring transparency and control to every transaction.\\
\\
![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f9f3cbd9d57d34d84f790f/66eb47d629634e1723f8cc60_progressBars.png)](https://www.alcove.io/#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-2)

## Streamlined, Integrated, and Easy to Use

### Early Stage Support

Our advisory services help early stage teams bridge the gap to creating scalable data management and project compliance plans.

### Digitize Frameworks

Alcove converts compliance workflows and methodology requirements into straightforward tasks.

### Collaborate

Effortlessly allocate responsibilities and critical data reporting to both internal stakeholders and external partners.

### Stay Compliant

Centralize project data to de-duplicate reporting processes across a variety of compliance goals, such as accreditation, permitting, etc.

### Automate LCAs

Simplify life cycle assessments and net quantification with automated calculations and dynamically linked evidence data.

### Manage Your Credits

Streamline commercial activities with bespoke tools to manage forward purchases, spot transactions, and complex invoicing across buyers.

Backed by top investors, leaders, and executives.
